newsitem.title: USA: Girl kills self after boyfriend row with parents.
newsitem.headline: Girl kills self after boyfriend row with parents.

text.p: A 16-year-old girl who was an outstanding student drowned herself after her parents told her to break up with a boyfriend she had met on the Internet, officials said on Monday.

The body of Dyung Vu, missing since last Thursday, was found floating in the Crystal Springs Reservoir, near San Francisco, Sunday afternoon, Lt. Larry Boss of the San Mateo County Sheriff's Department said.
Vu, ranked first in her high-school class, had recently been told by her parents to break up with a 20-year-old San Francisco man she had met on the Internet three weeks earlier, Boss said.

Vu, from Pacifica, near San Francisco, disappeared Thursday morning after telling the man she could not see him any more, Boss said. She left the college where she was studying and walked several miles down a trail to reach the reservoir, Boss said.
"She put her backpack on the ground (and) fully clothed jumped in the lake," he said.
Boss said there was nothing to indicate it was anything other than suicide. Investigators believed Vu was distraught over the breakup and took her own life, he said. "It's a very sad case," he said.
Boss said he did not know why the parents wanted her to break up with her boyfriend but thought it was probably because of the difference in their ages.
